stable-chest-pain-fixtures.ts binds seed 1624 and content 0.1.1 to expert, investigate-before-estimate error, recovery, and no-action paths. The three-month exertional history with its onset at about six minutes, resolution within four minutes of rest, and two-to-three-times-weekly frequency without progression, the absent rest, prolonged, syncopal, dyspneic and diaphoretic features, the resting observations, the fixed resting ECG report of sinus rhythm without ischemic ST-T change, the risk factors including hypertension, current tobacco use and an LDL of 168 mg/dL, and the authored not-very-low likelihood band are authored constants; no coronary, ischemic or event model is claimed, and no outcome follows from any choice. tests/integration/stable-chest-pain-runs.test.ts replays every path frame-for-frame across all three guidance levels and both practice regions.

The lesson advances through five recorded steps on the shared simulation clock in a strict order, and it is the first lesson given evidence in this repository with no time gate anywhere — appropriately, because nobody is deteriorating and nothing is racing. What the engine enforces is the order of reasoning itself: the trajectory before the characterization, the characterization before the likelihood, the likelihood before any testing intent, and the testing intent before the follow-up and safety net. Each step refuses until its predecessor is recorded, and repeating a recorded step changes nothing.

Five declared decisions verify a stable trajectory while preserving explicit acute-change triggers; characterize the symptom by what it actually does rather than by a label; integrate age, sex, symptoms, hypertension, tobacco use, LDL, examination findings and the resting ECG report into a likelihood band; record a patient-specific noninvasive-testing intent through shared decision-making against a local pathway; and record follow-up with the acute-change safety net. The lesson examines nobody, acquires or interprets no ECG, calculates no risk score, measures no exercise capacity, orders or performs no test, diagnoses no coronary disease or ischemia, prescribes no medication, determines no disposition, and predicts no event or outcome. No exact score and no universal modality is supplied, and the selection factors named — the clinical question, test strengths and limitations, exercise capacity, ECG interpretability, radiation and contrast, comorbidity, preference, access, local expertise and local quality — are the choice rather than a preamble to a fixed answer.
The scenario executes through the shared deterministic anesthesia engine rather than a display-only script.

The branch ends at the recorded follow-up and safety net with no diagnosis, no test ordered and no disposition. Later actions cannot restart an ended branch, and the ending certifies clinicalLikelihood as the authored not-very-low band rather than a number, exactScoreCalculated false, and testPerformed false. The acute-change triggers that would bring the patient back sooner are part of the ending rather than an appendix to it.

Five observed-state prompts at version 0.1.0 read the learner's own recorded steps. This is the first cardiology lesson to carry a tutor, and its register is deliberately unlike the emergency lessons that came before it: nobody is deteriorating, and the failure modes are a word, a number and a reflex. The word is "atypical", which the pattern beat refuses by name — it has meant everything from "not classic angina" to "probably nothing", it performs worse in women, and contemporary guidance has dropped it, so the beat records what happens, when, for how long and what relieves it instead. The number is an exact risk score: the likelihood beat says the authored answer is a band rather than a percentage, because the decision that follows turns on the band and not on a second decimal place, and it names the resting ECG as routinely over-read since a normal tracing in an asymptomatic patient tells you very little. The reflex is testing before estimating, which the engine ordering refuses and the testing beat answers by asking what question a test would answer first — with no universal modality, and with local access, expertise and quality named as part of the choice, since the best test on paper performed badly nearby is not the best test for this patient. The safety-net beat treats the close of a calm visit as the part that keeps working after the patient leaves. Worked example 0.1.0 drives the ordinary controls through the real engine to the recorded safety net, and its narration is generated from the tutor's own prose so the two cannot drift apart. A test asserts that no beat anywhere calls the symptom atypical, states a percentage likelihood, names a specific test as the answer, or diagnoses coronary disease. tests/unit/stable-chest-pain-demonstration.test.ts verifies observed response and every beat against the real engine, and tests/ui/cardiology-stable-chest-pain.test.tsx verifies the tray, silence when unassisted, stable controls while watching, and version binding.

src/modules/anesthesia/ui/Debrief.tsx maps all five objectives to accepted engine events; the no-action path meets none and the expert path meets all five. The counterfactual is the reflex the lesson exists to interrupt: the common-error path verifies the trajectory and characterizes the symptom correctly, then reaches for a testing pathway without ever estimating the likelihood that decides whether testing is appropriate at all, meeting two of five. The recovery path additionally characterizes before establishing the trajectory, takes the same investigate-before-estimate refusal, and still completes in order from the same positions.

clinic-stemi-fixtures.ts binds seed 3391 and content 0.1.1 to expert, screened-but-uncalled error, recovery, and no-action paths. The non-PCI clinic setting, the 22 minutes of ongoing symptoms, the fixed 12-lead report of ST elevation in II, III and aVF with reciprocal depression in I and aVL, the physiology at 128/76 with a heart rate of 62 and 96% on room air, the authored absences, and the two receiving-pathway questions left open — right-ventricular involvement and evolving bradyarrhythmia or atrioventricular block — are authored constants; no infarct, reperfusion or outcome model is claimed, and no outcome follows from any choice. tests/integration/clinic-stemi-runs.test.ts replays every path frame-for-frame across all three guidance levels and both practice regions.

The lesson advances through five recorded steps on the shared simulation clock. The transfer activation and the danger screen are unordered against each other, and the clinic bridge refuses until both are recorded; one time gate sits before the reassessment and handoff. The declared objective order lists the danger screen before the activation while the tray offers the activation first, which is the lesson's argument rather than an inconsistency: the call goes out while the screening happens rather than after it.

Five declared decisions reconcile the ongoing symptom against the fixed diagnostic ECG; activate EMS and the regional STEMI system with the ECG transmitted and the system-selected receiving team pre-alerted, rejecting private transport and biomarker or paperwork delay; screen current danger, alternatives, bleeding, allergy and oxygenation in parallel rather than as a precondition; record a setting-bounded bridge of aspirin suitability, monitoring, defibrillation readiness, access and transport intent; and reassess before handing off. The lesson examines nobody, acquires or interprets no ECG or test, diagnoses no real patient, prescribes or delivers no aspirin or other drug, selects no P2Y12 inhibition, anticoagulation, fibrinolysis, PCI, nitrate or opioid therapy, performs no procedure, determines no disposition, and predicts no complication or outcome. Destination and reperfusion selection stay with the regional pathway, and routine oxygen is explicitly not selected at the authored saturation.
The scenario executes through the shared deterministic anesthesia engine rather than a display-only script.

The branch ends at a recorded reassessment and handoff with the patient still in the clinic awaiting transport. Later actions cannot restart an ended branch, and the ending certifies pciCapableSetting false, biomarkerDelayUsed false, downstreamTherapySelected false and no delivered treatment, and preserves right-ventricular involvement and evolving block as open questions for the receiving team rather than conclusions.

Five observed-state prompts at version 0.1.0 read the learner's own recorded steps, and one of the five exists only for the state where the screen is done and nobody has been called. What the tutor holds is a setting: this is a clinic without a catheter laboratory, and almost everything a learner might reach for belongs to somebody down the road, so the two things that are genuinely theirs are the call and the honesty of the handover. The opening beat says the tissue clock started before she arrived and everything after either shortens the delay or lengthens it. The parallel beat argues the sequencing directly — the screening does not have to finish before the call goes out — and refuses private transport and biomarker delay by name, with the observation that a troponin an hour from now will say what is already known. The danger beat treats right-ventricular involvement and evolving block as items for the pre-alert rather than conclusions, and explains why an inferior pattern makes nitrates somebody else's decision. The bridge beat names routine oxygen at 96% as a habit rather than a treatment, and says why downstream therapy is not selected here. The handoff beat asks for the things the receiving team cannot reconstruct: the exact onset time, when the transmitted ECG was taken, and what has changed since. Worked example 0.1.0 drives the ordinary controls through the real engine to handoff, taking the unordered pair activation-first as the order the lesson argues for rather than the only one the engine allows, and its narration is generated from the tutor's own prose so the two cannot drift apart. A test asserts that no beat anywhere gives aspirin, selects a downstream therapy, orders oxygen, or names a destination. tests/unit/clinic-stemi-demonstration.test.ts verifies observed response and every beat against the real engine, and tests/ui/cardiology-clinic-stemi.test.tsx verifies the tray, silence when unassisted, stable controls while watching, and version binding.

src/modules/anesthesia/ui/Debrief.tsx maps all five objectives to accepted engine events; the no-action path meets none and the expert path meets all five. The counterfactual is the delay the lesson exists to refuse: the common-error path screens the dangers thoroughly and correctly with nobody called, then reaches for the bridge before the route is open, meeting two of five. The recovery path reaches for the bridge before there is a pattern, takes the unordered pair screen-first, and clears the handoff time gate on the second attempt, and still completes from the same positions.
